sections.title: 1. Browse & Install SOPs
sections.intro: SOPs are automation playbooks — pre-built workflows that generate videos, manage content, or run analytics automatically.

steps.title: Open SOP Marketplace
steps.desc: Go to SOP Marketplace from the sidebar. Browse 30+ official and community SOPs by category.

steps.title: Preview a SOP
steps.desc: Click any SOP card to see its description, steps, required inputs, and pricing. Official SOPs are free.

steps.title: Install
steps.desc: Click "Install" (or "Purchase" for community SOPs). The SOP appears in your "My SOPs" page instantly.

sections.tip: Start with the "Video Generation Starter" SOP — it's pre-installed for all users and demonstrates the full workflow.

sections.title: 2. Configure Your SOP
sections.intro: Each installed SOP can be customized before running.

steps.title: Open SOP Detail
steps.desc: Click any installed SOP in "My SOPs" to open its detail page with tabs: Overview, Runs, Edit, Webhook.

steps.title: Edit Configuration
steps.desc: Go to the "Edit" tab. Fill in the configuration form (niche, language, style, etc.). Each SOP has different options.

steps.title: Customize Playbook (Advanced)
steps.desc: The playbook is the step-by-step instruction set. Advanced users can edit the playbook markdown to change the SOP's behavior.

sections.tip: You can always reset to the default configuration by re-installing the SOP.

sections.title: 3. Run SOPs
sections.intro: Three ways to trigger a SOP run:

steps.title: Manual Run
steps.desc: Click "Run Now" on the SOP detail page (Overview tab). The SOP executes immediately and you can watch progress in real-time.

steps.title: Webhook Trigger
steps.desc: Go to the "Webhook" tab to get your webhook URL and secret. Send a POST request to trigger the SOP from external tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, etc.).

steps.title: Scheduled (Cron)
steps.desc: Some SOPs support automatic scheduling. When enabled, the server runs the SOP on a set schedule (e.g., daily at 6 AM).

sections.tip: Webhook format: POST to the webhook URL with header "x-sop-secret: YOUR_SECRET". Body is optional JSON with input overrides.

sections.title: 4. View Results & History
sections.intro: Track every SOP execution with detailed logs.

steps.title: Run History
steps.desc: Go to the "Runs" tab on any SOP detail page. See all past runs with trigger type (manual/webhook/cron), status, start time, and duration.

steps.title: Run Detail & Timeline
steps.desc: Click "View Mission →" on any run to see the step-by-step execution timeline. Each step shows its status, output, and timing.

steps.title: Run Statuses
steps.desc: Pending = queued, Running = in progress, Completed = success, Failed = error occurred. Failed runs show error details in the timeline.

sections.title: 5. Create Custom SOPs (MASTER)
sections.intro: MASTER-tier users can create and sell custom SOPs on the marketplace.

steps.title: Open SOP Creator
steps.desc: Go to "SOP Creator" in the sidebar (MASTER only). Click "Create New SOP".

steps.title: Define Your SOP
steps.desc: Fill in the name (EN + VI), category, description, and playbook. The playbook defines each step the SOP will execute.

steps.title: Set Pricing
steps.desc: Free or paid. For paid SOPs, set a price and earn commission on every sale through the marketplace.

steps.title: Publish
steps.desc: Save as draft to test, then publish to make it available on the marketplace for all users.

sections.tip: Test your SOP thoroughly before publishing. Install it yourself first and run it to verify all steps work correctly.

sections.title: 6. Challenges & Rewards
sections.intro: Complete challenges to earn rewards and boost your earnings.

steps.title: View Active Challenges
steps.desc: Go to "Challenges" in the sidebar. See all active challenges with progress bars and deadlines.

steps.title: Track Progress
steps.desc: Each challenge tracks your progress automatically. Run SOPs, make sales, or earn commission to advance.

steps.title: Claim Rewards
steps.desc: When you complete a challenge, claim your reward: badges, MCU credits, or commission boosts.

sections.tip: Challenges refresh periodically. Check back regularly for new opportunities.
